scientific_review: Four author-reported Brazil Current mean modal-fit vertical extents: MARLIM350m, DFBS400m, C3550m, W333850m. Nominal sites and month-precision record bounds retained from Table1; these are different historical records, not a synoptic or annual profile.

Mean profiles reconstructed using five gravest dynamical modes and WOA2009 stratification. Source instrument gaps, filling methods, local along-front rotation and low-pass processing remain explicit. Bathymetry, instrument sampling limits, transport and underlying IWBC are separate quantities.

DFBS mean has low statistical significance in the source. The default scenario retains its provisional400m descriptor; the support-filtered field is unknown at DFBS and both adjacent intervals, without bridging the flagged site. This is not a statistical confidence interval.

Nominal WGS84 mooring connector is reference geometry, not a measured current axis. Source anchors retain exact nominal coordinates. Derived cumulative kilometres and computed coordinates serialize to six decimals solely for cross-platform reproduction, without asserting physical accuracy.

Depth descriptors interpolate only between adjacent source anchors and round to50m for display. No extrapolation, monthly seasonal cycle, whole-route physical depth, thickness or whole-current volume is admitted.

Primary author-hosted original PDF inspected: Table1 and Figure6 pages rendered, mean-depth values transcribed from Section2.3 prose. No figure digitization or PDF redistribution. Figure6 nominal metadata inconsistencies are documented using Table1 coordinates/bathymetry.

All prior eleven scenario records, previous quantity cells, depth registers and eddy measurements remain preserved. Eighty-eight source/profile checks plus six baseline checks passed in cloud; no local tests or raw ocean-field processing.
